title: garnotia patula
intro: Garnotia patula, commonly known as the Chinese or Indian staminal, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its use in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Garnotia patula include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting the body against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
